moodBoard.title: Style and mood at a glance
moodBoard.intro: Warm page, white lifts, charcoal primary actions, orange only for focus and brand emphasis. Status yellow and booking pills stay separate from the brand accent.
moodBoard.typographyCaption: DM Sans as serif headline and sans UI. One family, two roles.
moodBoard.sampleBody: Mara Keller cooks an autumn menu for your birthday dinner in Munich.
moodBoard.helperMeta: Helper text and metadata stay text-sm muted.
moodBoard.controlsCaption: Primary in charcoal. Focus ring in accent. Forms on secondary (white) over the warm canvas.
moodBoard.statusCaption: Status banners and badges (blue/green/yellow/red) beside booking pills. Orange focus next to warning without competing.
moodBoard.introCallWaiting: An intro call is waiting for your confirmation.
moodBoard.cardFamilyCaption: Discovery tiles and booking cards on the same warm canvas. Density and hover should feel related.
moodBoard.roastDuckDescription: Juicy duck breast with apple red cabbage and port jus.
moodBoard.attentionCaption: Attention banner and offer chat share status colors and composer chrome with the rest of the platform.
moodBoard.sidebarMock: Sidebar mock: warning badge and unread counts use the same status language as banners and cards.
